events.title: The Astrocraft Demo is OUT NOW!
events.summary: Greetings Astro-Tycoons! The airlock is open: the Astrocraft Demo is now available on Steam! Open your own shop on a space station: mine asteroids, craft goods in your machines, stock the shelves and serve the space travelers who dock at your station. Get your first robot to keep production running, build a landing pad and grow from a lone miner into a station owner, solo or in online co-op for up to four players. events.title: Astrocraft Demo launches on October 12
events.summary: Greetings Astro-Tycoons! We have a date: the Astrocraft Demo arrives on Steam on October 12. In the demo you land on a barren asteroid with little more than a mining laser and a gravity generator. Mine your first ore, smelt it in your first machines, then build your own shop, stock the shelves and serve the space travelers who dock at your station.
